about: Ladder of test questions per source. level: 1 direct, 2 direct variant, 3 needs disambiguation, 4 needs a period or date, 5 several facts, 6 trap (must NOT be answered), 7 wrong source (the connector must not be offered). expect.kind: contains_any (the answer states one of the strings), contains_all (every group has one of its strings), not_established (an honest 'not established' is the only pass), time_sensitive (no fixed answer: needs a dated source or an honest not-established). Only a wrong answer fails; 'not established' passes except where the case is contains_*, where it is recorded as a miss. Answers were checked against the sources named in 'check'.
